testcase.name: Replace and Merge each restore the chosen file in their mode and say Restore complete
with no recording a restore may start
Cancel writes nothing, deletes nothing, and returns to the Backup section
a write that fails after the file exists deletes that file and asks, with the owner's words
a delete that fails is logged at warn and the person is told nothing extra
a failed restore shows no loading page and reloads nothing
having been asked in an earlier session, turning scheduled backups on asks for nothing
a recording that starts while the prompt is up still blocks Replace and Merge, and restores nothing
a restore cannot be started while a track is recording, and nothing is touched
a new empty file is not asked about
with a folder chosen the automatic backup turns on, is saved, and is scheduled at its frequency
the automatic backup is off by default, with no folder, and the messages are the approved words
once Replace is confirmed, a Try again after unreadable photos does not ask again
Replace writes the backup into the file
a scheduled-backup notice that could not be a notification is offered once at launch, and forgotten after
a size the provider does not give is asked about, the safe way round, and the reason is logged
Try again with the photos still unreadable asks again
after a restore the page is Loading while the screens reload, then Done
Cancel saves nothing and deletes the file this run created, and only that file
Try again after a failed write asks the screen to open the Save picker again
Done is not offered before the reload has finished
changing how often re-schedules an enabled backup, and turning it off cancels the schedule
choosing a file to restore asks first and restores nothing until Replace or Merge is chosen
a chosen restore file that cannot be read is a failed restore before any prompt result
with no notice waiting nothing is offered
a saved schedule is read back when the screen starts
turning it on with no folder does not use up the one ask
tapping Done asks the screen for the Maps tab at once, and the page leaves after its animation
one photo left out is worded in the singular, verb and all
a file that already has contents is asked about first, and nothing is opened or written
a restore that fails says Couldn't restore that backup and logs why
turning the automatic backup on with no folder leaves it off and says so
turning scheduled backups on for the first time asks for the notification permission, and off and on again does not
Try again reads the photos again, and saves the backup if they can be read now
a file that cannot be opened is a failed backup, not a crash and not a success
Continue without files saves the backup without them and says how many were left out
unreadable photos pause the backup before anything is written, and the prompt says how many
one unreadable photo is worded in the singular
Back up now writes the backup to the chosen file and says Backup saved
Cancel closes the prompt and restores nothing
an unreadable saved schedule is logged, and the section starts from the off default rather than guessing
a backup that fails after its file exists removes the file and asks, rather than saying Couldn't save
Cancel after a failed write closes the prompt and does not ask for a file
